theorem: The observed-HMM Hellinger recursion is a positive transfer operator on the compact two-belief square. Adjacent binary64 intervals enclose every exact decimal input coefficient; the interval boxes cover the square, and outward recursion encloses T^n 1 pointwise between m and M. Positivity gives m^(1/n)<=r(T)<=M^(1/n) by order bounds, hence the direct asymptotic rate enclosure. Intersecting it with the independent earlier quasi-multiplicative certificate gives the tighter displayed combined interval.
